The user specifically says: "Before attempting to start the engine, kindly verify that every car door is meticulously secured—acknowledge once confirmed. Should everything be aligned, proceed with activating the START mode."

We have a tool called lockDoors that can lock or unlock doors. We also have a tool called displayCarStatus that can show the status of the doors. The user wants us to confirm that every car door is locked. So we need to check the status of each door. The user didn't specify which doors. The user said "every car door" so we need to check all four doors: driver, passenger, rear_left, rear_right.

We can use displayCarStatus with option "doors". That will give us the status of the doors. Then we can confirm that they are all locked. Then we can start the engine. The user wants us to acknowledge once confirmed. So we can do that after we confirm that all doors are locked.

We can do a single tool call to displayCarStatus with option "doors". Then we can parse the result. Then we can confirm that all doors are locked. Then we can start the engine. The user wants us to do that. So let's do it.
